title: Correction to: The Fossilized Birth–Death Model Is Identifiable
content: This is a correction to: Kate Truman, Timothy G Vaughan, Alex Gavryushkin, Alexandra “Sasha” Gavryushkina, The Fossilized Birth–Death Model Is Identifiable, Systematic Biology, Volume 74, Issue 1, January 2025, Pages 112–123, https://doi.org/10.1093/sysbio/syae058
